title: KINETIC MOTION REEL 2026 (v2)
revision: v2 — ground-up rebuild after human rejection of r03 ('1800s look', 'sound horrible')

brand.name: kinetic
brand.headline: kinetic thinks in motion.
brand.mark: own 12-petal coral starburst (never the Claude mark)

stage.engine: Blender 4.3.2 Cycles CPU, AgX Punchy, 20 samples + adaptive 0.06, no OIDN (shadow-denoise in grade.py)
stage.scene: laptop 0.322x0.228m deck / 0.212m lid @102deg, 70 keys, trackpad, glossy dark desk, dark room
stage.camera: 70mm @ ~1.2m, screen-height, -5deg dutch roll, DOF f/5.6, drift +-1cm, punch-ins at cuts, push-in on end card

acts.design: coral capsule elastic hops on ruler, glow trail
Archivo Black motion design: whip smears, invert flash 1.95, letter flips, coral tittles, zoom-through 3.95
burst, dot sphere, glowing rings, dot terrain, tight spiral rose, implode
clay metaballs (field+normals+spec+shadow), merge, mitosis, bead row
navy dashboard: rolling KPIs, sparkline, staggered bars

score.map: intro pluck 0, drop 1.55 (kick/clap/sub), hats 4.35, fill+riser 5.28, arp 6.0, pad lift 8.0, busiest 10.0, sweep-down 11.02, 4 montage hits 11.55, impact+chord tail 12.0
score.production: layered kick, sidechained sub, staggered claps, dark hats, filtered saw plucks/pads, reverb send, bus saturation, -16 LUFS fit
